profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Walmart
profile.summary: Passionate about learning new technologies and applying them to solve real-world problems. I enjoy working with cross-functional teams and collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and business analysts to create innovative and impactful solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Led and mentored a team of 4 engineers to successfully design and implement web, mobile and backend app within 6 months, to efficiently track, manage, and resolve freight issues during receiving processes.
* Streamlined the freight issue resolution process by designing and implementing business rules for automated issue resolution, reducing manual intervention and significantly speeding up operational workflows.
* Architected and delivered scalable, reliable solutions for new feature requirements and system enhancements.
* Implemented comprehensive monitoring and observability using tools like Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana, enabling proactive issue detection, fast resolution, and data-driven decision-making in production environments.
* Led the phased deployment of the application across over 25 distribution centers, coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent performance, successful rollouts, and minimal disruption to daily operations.
* Own and drive the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), from translating business requirements into actionable technical solutions, to managing infrastructure setup, development, testing, and deployment, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
* Tech stack involved : Java, Springboot, Apache Kafka, Azure Kubernetes(AKS), Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Azure SQL, restful APIs, Kotlin, React, Android, CICD, Mockito, JUnit

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Warehouse Management System(WMS) | Supply Chain:

Replaced legacy WMS with new, cloud-based Sam’s WMS with extensible, loosely coupled and event-driven architecture. 
o This allowed for seamless integration and data availability across platforms.
o Reduced cost, improving velocity, automating processes, and supporting real time visibility in 
   warehouse Ops.
o Implemented best software engineering practices to write reusable, clean, flexible, and testable 
   codebase that increased productivity for middleware applications integrating WMS and host systems.

Leadership:
o. Led and drove the sessions for discovery, design planning and detailed requirements of the 
    implementation of middleware integration platform.
o. Worked also as a Scrum Master for the team for 7 months, implementing the agile ways of working, 
    collaborating with PMs to understand the functional requirements, working with the engineering team 
    to track progress, addressing any roadblocks, and keep the team aligned to the goals.
o. Currently leading the team of more than 10 engineers for implementing a new WMS solution for 
    Grocery warehouse for the pilot site and expanding the solution across multiple Sam’s Grocery 
    warehouses.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Warehouse Management System(WMS) | Supply Chain:

Developed a middleware layer consisting of a suite of applications between WMS and more than 15 other Sam’s host systems.
o      This entailed seamless data transformation, cleaning, filtering, and data communication across the network.
o	Leveraged Kafka queues & topics, Azure service buses, Azure logic app & function app to develop integration channels for WMS. 
o	Implemented relational DB schemas for Azure SQL server to store data in middleware platform and deployed these applications to Walmart private cloud and AKS.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Transportation Management System(TMS) | Supply Chain:
o  Contributed to developing a load building, planning, and integrating solution for shipping out items in outbound trailers from warehouse using REST APIs.
o  Worked on creating and optimizing a load planning algorithm using Julia Lang.

positions.title: Teaching Associate
positions.description:
o Teaching Faculty for Intro to programming lab course at CSUEB.
o Taught the concepts and the practical implementation of C++ and core JAVA programming       
  language to Undergraduate Computer Science class. 
o Taught the fundamentals of Object Oriented programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
o  Benefited the organization with my proficiency in front end technologies like JSP, HTML5, CSS, AJAX, back-end technologies like JAVA, Hibernate MVC, Servlet and database like MySQL.   
o  Developed a PaaS platform for code, compilation and execution of JAVA programs providing a live production environment where users can work from anywhere across the globe.
o  Used Javascript, CSS3, HTML5, JSP, Ajax for front-end; JAVA, Hibernate, MVC, Servlet for back-end; AWS-EC2 for cloud deployment.

positions.title: JAVA Trainee
positions.description: o  Professionally trained in JAVA learning the core concepts of it deeply and conceptually.

projects.title: Compiler for Little Algol
projects.description: Creating a compiler from scratch to end implementing all the phases of compiler building from Symbol Table, Scanner, Parser to Code Generation. The project is entirely implemented in JAVA.

projects.title: Coder's Hub- Online IDE for JAVA
projects.description:
--This system is a solution to PC dependency for coding and execution of java code on local machine.
--This system would provide a PaaS platform for code compilation and execution and for data storage on cloud. User would be able to access the data anywhere, anytime and can work on their projects. 
Our system would use AWS cloud services for better performance and security. 
--The user would be able to download the project in the form of war file. The system supports J2EE architecture. It provides a live production environment where user can work from anywhere across the globe.
Technologies used:  JAVA, Hibernate MVC, JSP, Servlet, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Ajax, AWS- EC2
